answer: Latency triangulation: 1) Each epoch, ten random verifiers on different continents send an agent a fresh cipher nonce and time its signed reply. 2) Light in fibre needs about 5 ms per 1,000 km, so round-trip times pin each agent to a region. 3) Clones on one server share one crystal-clear latency fingerprint and merge into one identity. Each fake must rent its own machine in a distinct location, about $5 a month, re-proven every epoch so nothing replays. Only a few hundred hosting regions exist, so ivory-tower clone farms collapse and the attack stops paying.
